name: Quickchange — "becomes the color or colors of your choice" takes its colour from the colour dropdown
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (clusters 'becomes the color of your choice' / 'color or colors of your choice'). The effect is a SET_COLOR with params.colorChoice and no colours (the engine skips it until a colour is picked); the spell gets needsChosenColor so the colour dropdown shows, and Battlefield.setChosenColor fills the colour in place without re-parsing, so the chosen target survives. The second Quickchange has a target but no colour chosen and must leave the Ogre red, not turn it colourless. The fixture is restored from a serialized board, so it also covers saving the choice.
